stories.title: Two dead after fire breaks out on sinking ship in Black Sea as Zelensky blames Russian drones

en.title: Two dead after fire breaks out on sinking ship in Black Sea as Zelensky blames Russian drones
en.summary: A fire broke out on a ship sinking in the Black Sea on Monday, resulting in two deaths. Ukrainian President Zelensky attributed the incident to Russian drone activity.

stories.title: US closely monitoring case of lab worker who ‘possibly’ died of plague in Siberia, says Rubio

en.title: US closely monitoring case of lab worker who 'possibly' died of plague in Siberia, says Rubio
en.summary: A Russian laboratory worker at a plague research institute in Siberia died following a reported accident. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated the US is monitoring the case while noting it is not cause for alarm.

stories.title: What is the plague? How the deadly disease spreads after suspected case in Russia

en.title: What is the plague? How the deadly disease spreads after suspected case in Russia
en.summary: An article explains plague disease transmission following a suspected case in Russia. The disease has historically caused hundreds of millions of deaths.

stories.title: Former Panorama editor Rachel Jupp appointed as head of BBC News

en.title: Former Panorama editor Rachel Jupp appointed as head of BBC News
en.summary: Rachel Jupp, a former Panorama editor, has been appointed head of BBC News. The appointment aims to address concerns about trust in mainstream news coverage and follows the departure of previous director Deborah Turness.

en.title: Police apply to keep details of Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor legal claim secret
en.summary: Police have requested that details of a legal claim involving Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor remain confidential. A private High Court hearing is scheduled to address this matter.

stories.title: Daniil Medvedev disqualified from China Open semi after hitting fan with ball

en.title: Daniil Medvedev disqualified from China Open semi after hitting fan with ball
en.summary: Tennis player Daniil Medvedev was disqualified from his China Open semi-final against Novak Djokovic after striking a ball into the crowd that hit a spectator in the eye. Djokovic advanced to the final against De Minaur.

en.title: US 'monitoring' situation around suspected case of plague in Russia
en.summary: Moscow has implemented extensive quarantine measures in Siberia following the death of a worker at a plague research institute. The United States is tracking developments in the situation.

en.title: No 10 insists RAF Fairford is safe after US withdraws its bombers from base
en.summary: The US military withdrew a dozen B-1 bombers from RAF Fairford in Gloucestershire due to security concerns over a potential Iranian threat. The UK government stated the base remains secure.
